text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued November 13, 2022, Appeal DDRT2023-16.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Deferred consideration of Appeal DDRT2023-16 to its meeting on October 12, 2023 at 9:30 a.m., or as soon as possible thereafter, and marked the new hearing date peremptory on the Applicant. 2. Directed that the Order (November 13, 2022) remain in force and effect during the time that the appeal hearing is pending.
